A professional gaming timer designed for competitive Dota2 players. It tracks runes, item cooldowns, and crucial game objectives with real-time alerts and notifications to give you tactical advantages. How does the Roshan timer work? The Roshan timer is manual - start it when Roshan dies. It tracks the 8-11 minute respawn window and provides alerts 30 seconds before the earliest respawn time, helping your team secure the next Roshan. What timers are included in Dota2 presets? Includes Rune timer (2-min intervals), Healing Lotus (3-min), Wisdom Runes (7-min), Tormentor (20-min shard availability), and Roshan respawn timer. All customizable with pre-alerts. Is the Dota2 Timer Tool free? Yes! Completely free with no limitations. All features including multiple timers, custom alerts, gaming presets, and notifications are available at no cost.
